provenance.label: RECONSTRUCTED
provenance.statement: Monthly levels are a reconstructed replay of the current LEVEL engine at each cutoff, using only observations whose reference period is on or before that cutoff. They are not historical real-time published snapshots.
provenance.graph_month: The path period is the scoring cutoff month, not necessarily the economic source period.
provenance.source_period: source_period is the dimension as_of (latest scored component reference period) at that cutoff. It may be earlier than the graph month.

derived_composite.label: proposed
derived_composite.scope: Dashboard visualization only. Does not replace calibrated levels or the production equal-weight mean.

published_snapshots.note: Observed published score state. Not a reconstructed monthly path and not a historical real-time vintage of earlier months.
